candidate_sentences.text: During the second quarter of 2026, AS LHV Group reported a consolidated net profit of EUR 24.7 million, reflecting an increase of EUR 5 million compared to the EUR 19.7 million recorded in the first quarter of 2026, but a decrease compared to the EUR 30.8 million posted in the second quarter of 2025.
The Group’s consolidated net income for Q2 2026 reached EUR 79.0 million, representing a 7.3% increase from EUR 73.7 million in Q1 2026 and a growth from EUR 73.9 million in Q2 2025.

details.coherence_justification: The summary contains a significant self-contradiction between S1 (consolidated net profit of EUR 24.7 million) and S5 (consolidated net income of EUR 79.0 million) for Q2 2026. These are presented as distinct figures without explanation, implying they are both measures of the same underlying performance metric. This creates confusion about which figure represents the Group's actual profitability. While other relationships between figures (e.g., quarter-on-quarter changes) are logically presented, this fundamental contradiction undermines the overall coherence of the summary. The remaining sentences show generally logical relationships and organization, but the contradiction is severe enough to warrant a 'Not generally' rating.
